answer: Snapshot as of October 3, 2026. (1) September 30, 2026: Cal-Maine reported fiscal Q1 2027 (13 weeks ended August 29, 2026): net sales USD 539.6 million (-41.5% from USD 922.6 million), gross profit USD 0.4 million, operating loss USD 82.2 million and a net loss attributable of USD 58.6 million, or USD 1.26 per diluted share, versus net income of USD 199.3 million (USD 4.12) a year earlier [H20-E1][H20-E3]. Conventional shell egg net sales fell 59.5% on a 59.3% lower average selling price (segment loss USD 71.0 million); Specialty Shell Eggs and Prepared Foods rose to 54.1% of net sales [H20-E1]. (2) Under the variable dividend policy no dividend is payable for the quarter; USD 94.5 million of cumulative loss must be recovered before any future dividend [H20-E1]. (3) Buybacks: 66,601 shares for USD 5.0 million in the quarter (USD 315.7 million left of the USD 500 million program) and 204,888 shares for USD 14.9 million after quarter end [H20-E1]. (4) On August 31, 2026 (8-K filed September 2) the company entered into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement: a five-year senior unsecured revolver of up to USD 250 million (accordion up to another USD 250 million), maturing August 31, 2031, with nothing borrowed at September 1 [H20-E2]. Secondary coverage corroborates the loss and dividend decision [H20-E4].
